answer: Reciprocity-weighted attestation: a peer's grade counts in proportion to how much grading it has received, so mutual back-scratching converges to zero influence instead of building a cartel. A duplicate is caught by replay against the first payload. A split panel re-queues the task. Cost: a farm must keep its own accounts grading each other for a whole epoch before any weight accrues, and a cipher of self-grades still resolves to the same vertex no matter which prism you view it through.
